labels.label: 3D sphere at the anchor
labels.tooltip: Draw a wireframe sphere IN the scene at the anchor — depth tested, so the point reads at its true depth

labels.label: Sphere size −
labels.tooltip: Smaller label sphere markers

labels.label: Sphere size +
labels.tooltip: Bigger label sphere markers

labels.label: Solid sphere
labels.tooltip: Fill the sphere (shaded, with the opacity below) instead of drawing a wireframe

labels.label: Sphere opacity −
labels.tooltip: More translucent label spheres

labels.label: Sphere opacity +
labels.tooltip: More opaque label spheres

labels.label: Label color / Text color / Leader line
labels.tooltip: Colours for the selected labels — or, with nothing selected, for the next labels you create.

labels.label: Opacity
labels.tooltip: Label background opacity, 0.1–1.

labels.label: Snap anchor to nearest item
labels.tooltip: A tag with children anchors at its bounding-box center — on a bent pipe run that point hangs in empty air. This snaps the anchor to the nearest child item instead.

labels.label: Label text without leading /
labels.tooltip: Show the tag without the model's leading “/” in the label itself. The label stays linked to the full name, so selection, colouring and viewpoints still match.

labels.label: Store
labels.tooltip: Resolve tags only among models loaded from one store — All stores searches every loaded model

labels.label: Append
labels.tooltip: Add labels for these tags (existing labels are kept; duplicates skipped)

labels.label: Replace
labels.tooltip: Delete all labels, then add labels for these tags

labels.label: Tag list
labels.tooltip: Paste tag names, one per line. Names that are not found are written back here.

labels.label: Label swatch
labels.tooltip: Toggle selected

labels.label: Move label
labels.icon: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="tabler-icon tabler-icon-crosshair "><path d="M4 8v-2a2 2 0 0 1 2 -2h2"></path><path d="M4 16v2a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h2"></path><path d="M16 4h2a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v2"></path><path d="M16 20h2a2 2 0 0 0 2 -2v-2"></path><path d="M9 12l6 0"></path><path d="M12 9l0 6"></path></svg>
labels.tooltip: Move this label: activate, then click the new spot in the model (disarms after one click)

labels.label: Delete label
labels.icon: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="tabler-icon tabler-icon-trash "><path d="M4 7l16 0"></path><path d="M10 11l0 6"></path><path d="M14 11l0 6"></path><path d="M5 7l1 12a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h8a2 2 0 0 0 2 -2l1 -12"></path><path d="M9 7v-3a1 1 0 0 1 1 -1h4a1 1 0 0 1 1 1v3"></path></svg>
labels.tooltip: Delete this label

labels.label: Label text
labels.tooltip: Edit what the label says. With Styled text on, this is a multi-line box where **bold** works.

labels.label: Linked fullname
labels.tooltip: The model item the label belongs to. Highlight, viewpoints and duplicate checks use it.
